budget_unit: B and c_d are in units of c0 under both conventions (lead decisions L15 (3)): under C-full the unit is 1 FRE, the full cost of one full trial; under C-lean the unit is the measured lean job c0 (references draft LQ31). Predictions are curves in c_d/c0; the measured c0 only places a result on them (U3 (a))

C-full.source: stage-1 pre-registration DRAFT rev 2 (9ff29fc1) section 10.2 table (wave-0a ledgers, cost records only; Gate B values, named for REQ-21 (m))
C-full.stages: training 219.7 s = the median training of R_1-R_3; evaluation 2,623.2 s = the per-stage medians of greedy generation (1,694), sampled generation (638), Qwen3Guard (177), harm scores (103) and the task-loss pass (11.2); setup 91.1 s = the rest of the job slot (load, tokenize, edit, ARC, verification); a psi-trial scales the evaluation, a phi-trial the training
C-full.unit: 1 FRE = 2,934 s, the median job slot of the three wave-0a R arms (references draft LQ25; fixed at the W1-P commit, never re-estimated)

C-lean.contents_rule: LQ27 (a) is the default (lead reading; [USER] if the lead reads it as a change to PLAN-S:202, then (b) is in force)
C-lean.source: references DRAFT rev 2 (5835caae) sections C.5-C.6 (E; the c0 job measures the real value)

a.stages: evaluation = 200 harm prompts x 1 sampled answer with its guard (245 s) + the task-loss pass (11 s) + the 100 greedy over-refusal answers (362 s) and their guard (17 s)
a.unit: c0 = 870 s (LQ29: a cold start, the full training of an R arm, exactly this lean evaluation)

b.stages: the screen's O and L come at their full-evaluation cost (362 + 17 + 11 = 390 s), paid by every full run
b.unit: c0 = 480 s (PLAN-S:202 as written: training plus 200 harm prompts x 1 sample)

diagnostic.rule: pays c_d out of B; if c_d > B it cannot run and the policy picks keep; if B - c_d < 2 it picks keep (lead decisions L15 (3)); else it keeps the k options with the highest scores (ties by the sealed tie order) and keep, which top-k never drops (L15 (2)), and runs the cell's frozen runs-only rule on them in the sealed tie order with budget B - c_d; bisection becomes halving (L15 (8))

limits.source: O(theta0) = 17/100 (Gate A untuned unit); tau_O grid (FOCUS 8 Oct); tau_L = 2 sqrt(2) s from tau_l_check.out.json (d822ba18), lead decisions addendum (11477648) L16

category.note: the 8 Gate B units (removal of one unit's 600 rows); keep = a0 at Gate A seeds 1101-1103; option ids are the Dolly category names (a replay maps the unit ids onto them)

llama_category.note: Llama's Gate B-lite menu: the same 8 units; OLMo-calibrated (no Llama measurement is an input; Llama note section 15 item 2)

method.note: the stage-1 primary arms; keep = a0 1101-1106; an object of the spec only (REQ-18 predicts the category and planted menus)

name: selector_spec
option_cost_rule: every option's full-run cost is 1 FRE (cost_fre 1.0): the convention's cost model prices every trial, and menu_from refuses another value (a per-option cost is not built; verifier N-3)

pick.rule: among the options with at least 2 full-run seeds that pass the screen: the largest shrunk estimate of G = mean U of keep's seeds - mean full-run U of the option; a tie goes to the raw estimate, then to the sealed tie order; keep unless the best shrunk estimate is above 0 (a tie with keep goes to keep). Seeds are not paired (PLAN-S:102, the model in force)

planted_geometry.note: the planted corpus as ADD L12 builds it with no near-duplicate pairs: 8 units x 4 quartiles of 150 rows x 4 quarters of 37, 38, 37, 38 rows; the plant's 37 rows replace a 37-row leaf

psi_subsample.rule: a psi-trial replayed from saved labels uses the sealed sample of round(psi x n) harm prompts of that (option, seed index), parts (option id, seed index, psi written as %g); each psi level is its own sample (the simulation's model gives each psi level its own subsample deviation)

requirement: REQ-16 (brief rev 1 (12cbf463)); lead decisions addendum (11477648) L15 (2), (3), (8), L16; W1 builder extract rev 2 (18b81b26) W1-13

bisection.rule: nested menus only: from the root of the binary tree over the cells in nesting order, run t screen trials (seeds 0..t-1) on both halves of the current group and follow the half with the lower mean U (a tie follows the left half); the leaf reached gets 2 full-run seeds; t = the largest value whose descent and promotion cost at most B; the rest buys more seeds for the leaf. A group trial removes every cell of the group; its true effect is the sum of its cells' effects (additivity, an assumption)

halving.rule: rungs: the screen trial, the psi ladder of the same trained model (seed 0), then one more full-run seed per rung; ceil(n/2) options go on after each rung, until one option holds at least 2 full-run seeds; n_1 = the largest number of available options whose whole schedule costs at most B; the rest buys more full-run seeds for the options that hold 2 or more, round robin in rank order

one_shot.rule: screen n_s = min(available, floor((B - c_promote) / c_screen)) options in the sealed tie order with one trial each at the screen fidelity (seed 0); give the n_f = min(n_s, finalists, floor((B - n_s c_screen) / c_promote)) best 2 full-run seeds; spend the rest on more full-run seeds for them, round robin in rank order (at most max_seeds per option). The cap keeps the rule's E[G] from falling as B grows (without it, more budget spread 2 seeds over more finalists)

saved_labels.rule: per option and seed index: per-prompt Unsafe shares (u_prompts), per-prompt refusal flags (o_prompts), per-row task losses (l_rows); keep and the optional R arm (reference_r) the same; samples_per_prompt (top level) = the options' sampled answers per harm prompt, which must equal the convention's (C-full 3, C-lean 1), and keep.samples_per_prompt = C-full's 3 (keep's seeds are C-full runs at any convention); a replay of labels with another count refuses, so the replay has the model's sampling variance (verifier S-8; a lean replay of full evaluations would need a sealed 1-of-3 sample per prompt and a new registry key, not built). Version 2 adds the two counts

screen.coherence_rule: an option that fails the arm-pooled answers-end bar is infeasible (Draft B section F item 6); the simulation's default is that no option fails
screen.l_item_sd_note: not estimated here (no task-row table was read); 0 until the lead enters it if the HB form is adopted
screen.o_error_model_note: it must equal REQ-19's u8_decider (W1-13 row 2; K4)
screen.o_prompt_sd_source: CK-3 section 4.2 (Gate A: the paired per-prompt SE of O(a0 seed) - O(untuned) is 4.16, 4.22 and 3.91 pp at 100 prompts; their mean, rounded); seeds do not shrink it
screen.se_form_rule: pooled_residuals (lead decisions L16, in force): seed part = the pooled within-option variance of the full runs (options with 2 or more seeds and the comparison arm's seeds) / n; hb (Draft B A8, behind the switch): the option's own seed variance (ddof 1) / n + the comparison arm's own variance / its n, plus the crossed item part; O adds the prompt part under prompts_random in both forms
screen.tau_l_reference_note: a0 (PLAN-S:124, in force); r = the dose-matched random-removal arm (W1-13 row 4, to GPT). The screen uses the reference in force; a replay reports the L upper bound against both a0 and R (R when the saved labels hold its seeds; spec.l_bounds_report). In the simulation both references give the same truth while the true L effects and R's effect are 0 (the defaults), so the simulation runs the reference in force only
screen.uo_reading: REQ-16's 'with the U-O noise correlation from pooled residuals' is read as: the U-O correlation enters the generative model only (simulate.py: each full run's O seed noise is correlated with its standardized U noise, rho_UO from Gate A's a0 seeds); the screen bounds O and L separately and has no U-O term. A builder reading for REQ-21 (h) (verifier S-6); if the lead reads it as a screen rule (for example an O bound conditional on the U estimate), that rule is built behind a switch
screen.upper_quantile_reading: the upper end of the two-sided 90% interval (one-sided 95%), RB R1.2 and Draft B; Draft A proposes 0.90 (W1-13 row 1); REQ-21 (h) records the reading

shrinkage.method: normal-normal empirical Bayes, method of moments, per replicate over every option with at least one full-run seed: mu = their mean estimate, tau^2 = max(0, their variance (ddof 1) - their mean sampling variance), shrunk = mu + tau^2 / (tau^2 + v)(estimate - mu); v = the pooled U residual variance x (1/n + 1/J_keep)

ties.rule: the sealed order of a menu's option ids other than keep (sorted, then shuffled by the registry key); it is the visiting order of every rule and breaks every tie between options; a tie with keep goes to keep

phi_switch.note: phi < 1 trials (part training) exist neither on OLMo's category menu nor on Llama (Llama note section 15 item 3) and save at most 7.5% of a unit under C-full, so the default grid is {1}; with the switch the screen may run at phi = 0.5

trials.rule: a trial costs (setup + phi x training + psi x evaluation) / c0; raising psi of a trained model from a to b costs (b - a) x evaluation / c0; a full run is phi = psi = 1
